arxiv-2109-12922.title: ClipMatrix: Text-controlled Creation of 3D Textured Meshes
arxiv-2109-12922.creator: Nikolay Jetchev
arxiv-2109-12922.description: Abstract If a picture is worth thousand words, a moving 3d shape must be worth a million. We build upon the success of recent generative methods that create images fitting the semantics of a text prompt, and extend it to the controlled generation of 3d objects.

arxiv-2112-13428.title: ArT: All-round Thinker for Unsupervised Commonsense Question Answering
arxiv-2112-13428.creator: Jiawei Wang, Hai Zhao
arxiv-2112-13428.description: Abstract Without labeled question-answer pairs for necessary training, unsupervised commonsense question-answering (QA) appears to be extremely challenging due to its indispensable unique prerequisite on commonsense source like knowledge bases (KBs), which are usually highly resource consuming in construction. Recently pre-trained language models (PLMs) show effectiveness as an alternative for commonsense clues when they play a role of knowledge generator.

arxiv-2205-15087.title: An analysis of the spin density matrix of quarkonium in heavy ion collisions
arxiv-2205-15087.creator: Kayman J. Gonçalves,Giorgio Torrieri
arxiv-2205-15087.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kayman J. Gonçalves,Giorgio Torrieri. In this addendum to [ 1 ] , we apply the techniques developed in that paper to the J / Ψ J/\Psi and Υ \Upsilon spin alignement measurements in [ 2 ] . We argue that while the data points to a maximally impure density matrix, consistent with Cooper-Frye/Statistical model freeze-out, a measurement of the dependence of the ϕ \phi -sensitive coefficients on the azimuthal angle with respect to the reaction plane would be the crucial test of this conclusion.

arxiv-2305-00206.title: Tomographic Alcock–Paczyński Test with Redshift-Space Correlation Function: Evidence for the Dark Energy Equation of State Parameter w > − 1 w>-1
arxiv-2305-00206.creator: Fuyu Dong, Changbom Park, Sungwook E. Hong, Juhan Kim, Ho Seong Hwang, Hyunbae Park, Stephen Appleby
arxiv-2305-00206.description: Abstract The apparent shape of galaxy clustering depends on the adopted cosmology used to convert observed redshift to comoving distance, the r ⁡ ( z ) r(z) relation, as it changes the line elements along and across the line of sight differently. The Alcock-Paczyński (AP) test exploits this property to constrain the expansion history of the universe.

arxiv-2310-09258.title: Chiral Majorana hinge modes on a curved surface with magnetic impurities
arxiv-2310-09258.creator: Ilyoun Na, James G. McHugh, Sinéad M. Griffin, Luca Chirolli
arxiv-2310-09258.description: Abstract Chiral Majorana one-dimensional modes have been proposed as they key component for topological quantum computing. In this study, we explore their potential realization as hinge modes in higher-order topological superconductors. To create such phases, we engineer a sign-changing, time-reversal symmetry-breaking mass term through an ensemble of magnetic impurities on the surface of a sphere.

arxiv-2401-18068.title: Renormalization group flow and fixed-point in tensor network representations ipxm (テンソルネットワークによる繰り込み群フローと固定点の研究)
arxiv-2401-18068.creator: Atsushi Ueda ipxm 上田 篤
arxiv-2401-18068.description: Abstract We propose the integration of an energy-based finite-size scaling methodology with tensor network renormalization (TNR) techniques. TNR, serving as a numerical implementation of real-space renormalization group (RG) methods, provides a pathway to access the low-lying energy spectrum of various systems. By melding TNR with conformal perturbation theory, we can effectively calculate running coupling constants.

arxiv-2409-02694.title: Gravitational Surface Tension as the Origin for the Black Hole Entropy
arxiv-2409-02694.creator: S. D. Campos, R. H. Longaresi
arxiv-2409-02694.description: Abstract In this work, we explore the thermodynamics of black holes using the Gouy-Stodola theorem, traditionally applied to mechanical systems relating entropy production to the difference between reversible and irreversible work. We model black holes as gravitational bubbles with surface tension defined at the event horizon, deriving the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy relation for non-rotating black holes.

arxiv-2503-18250.title: Pad : Towards Efficient Data Generation for Transfer Learning Using Phrase Alignment
arxiv-2503-18250.creator: Jong Myoung Kim, Young-Jun Lee, Ho-Jin Choi, Sangkeun Jung
arxiv-2503-18250.description: Abstract Building training datasets for specific tasks is essential for service deployment, but it often requires significant time and cost. To address this issue, transfer learning using abundant English data has been widely adopted in non-English language model development. We propose a novel method, Phrase Aligned Data ( Pad ), to further improve the efficiency of transfer learning.

pmc-10742236.title: Prevalence of Variants of Uncertain Significance in Patients Undergoing Genetic Testing for Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer and Lynch Syndrome
pmc-10742236.creator: Pavlina Chrysafi, Chinmay T Jani, Margaret Lotz, Omar Al Omari, Harpreet Singh, Katherine Stafford, Lipisha Agarwal, Arashdeep Rupal, Abdul Qadir Dar, Abby Dangelo, Prudence Lam, David Wong
pmc-10742236.description: Simple SummaryThe increasing advancements in genetic testing have led to a rise in the number of patients undergoing cancer genetic testing who receive a VUS (variant of uncertain significance) result. This outcome leaves both patients and their healthcare providers perplexed, as they are unsure about the actual cancer risk and the necessary preventive measures.

pmc-10750976.title: Quality of Web-Based Sickle Cell Disease Resources for Health Care Transition: Website Content Analysis
pmc-10750976.creator: Thomas Annesi, Caren Steinway, Toyosi Oluwole, Steffi Shilly, Dava Szalda, Regina Myers, Jack Chen, Sophia Jan
pmc-10750976.description: BackgroundAdolescents and young adults with sickle cell disease (SCD) transitioning from pediatric to adult health care face a high-risk period associated with increased use of acute health care services and mortality. Although 59% of American citizens report using the internet for health care information, the quality of web-based, patient-facing resources regarding transition in SCD care has not been evaluated.

pmc-11546231.description: BackgroundHelicobacter Pylori (H. Pylori) is a pathogen that may invade the human stomach. In contrast to antibiotic treatment, which may lead to drug resistance, vaccination therapy is emerging as a possible immunotherapy option for H. Pylori.

pmc-11596955.description: This study aimed to describe a case of simultaneous guided bone regeneration (GBR) and implant placement in a patient with prior aesthetic implant failure, focusing on achieving optimal aesthetic and functional outcomes, and to perform a literature review of the current evidence.

pmc-12561420.title: Genomic Insights into an Environmental Vibrio parahaemolyticus Biofilm Isolate: Deciphering Alternative Resistance Mechanisms and Mobilizable Genetic Elements
pmc-12561420.creator: Huiyu Liu, Yujian Dong, Zhongyang Lin, Olivier Habimana, Marc Maresca, Manuel Simões
pmc-12561420.description: Background/Objectives: Biofilms are key in spreading antibiotic resistance in various ecosystems. This study employed comparative genomics to examine the resistance and adaptability mechanisms of the Vibrio parahaemolyticus strain Vaw-5, isolated from a seafood market biofilm. Methods: A comparative examination of Vaw-5 and 32 publicly available V. parahaemolyticus genomes identified a distinct set of genetic resistance characteristics.

pmc-12774910.title: Mechanisms of resistance to trastuzumab deruxtecan in breast cancer elucidated by multi-omic molecular profiling
pmc-12774910.creator: George W. Sledge, Joanne Xiu, Reshma L. Mahtani, Ana C. Sandoval Leon, Funda Meric-Bernstam, Jennifer R. Ribeiro, Ninad N. Kulkarni, Dileep R. Rampa, Jangsoon Lee, Naoto T. Ueno, Matthew J. Oberley, Milan Radovich, David B. Spetzler
pmc-12774910.description: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) is an antibody-drug conjugate successfully used to treat HER2-low and HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer, but resistance consistently develops. Using multivariate Cox proportional hazards in a real-world cohort of 2,799 patients with breast cancer, we aimed to identify clinically relevant T-DXd resistance mechanisms.

pmc-12828631.title: Investigation of the Frequency of Femoroacetabular Impingement Using Computed Tomography Images
pmc-12828631.creator: Kemal Yazici, Muhammed Yasir Altunisik, Burak Aydin, Seyran Kılınç, Zekeriya Öztemur

Previously taken CT images of the patients were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-13099667.title: Magnetic resonance imaging and the evaluation of vestibular schwannomas: a systematic review
pmc-13099667.creator: Keng Siang Lee, Navodini Wijetilake, Steve Connor, Tom Vercauteren, Jonathan Shapey
pmc-13099667.description: IntroductionThe assessment of vestibular schwannoma (VS) requires a standardized measurement approach as growth is a key element in defining treatment strategy for VS. Volumetric measurements offer higher sensitivity and precision, but existing methods of segmentation, are labour-intensive, lack standardisation and are prone to variability and subjectivity.
